images.alt_en: Illustration inspired by the story: At twenty to six on the seventh morning, Orsa Keller unlatched the cold-room door of her bakery in Kesselbach and found a second kitchen on the other side, as she had every morning that week.
images.alt_sl: Ilustracija po zgodbi: Dvajset minut do šestih sedmega jutra je Orsa Keller odpahnila vrata hladilnice v svoji pekarni v Kesselbachu in na drugi strani zagledala drugo kuhinjo, kakor vsako jutro tistega tedna.
